tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: dpal rdo rje gzhon nu thugs kyi thig le las: lha dbang bzhugs so:
thugs dam gsang ba'i lha mchog dpal rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo:
rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha dbang bskur ba ni:

hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i lte ba nas: mi gnas mi 'gyur dpal chen ku mā ra: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs shes rab yum dang sbyor: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba big nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya wā ka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: steng gi phyogs nas thog chen 'beb mdzad pa: hūm̐ kār sgra 'byin phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badzra kro dha hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐: gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya wā ka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: shar gyi phyogs nas dgra bgegs gzir mdzad pa: rnam rgyal snyems ma stag dang bya rgod mgo: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badzra kro dha bi dza ya hūm̐: ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya wā ka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: shar lho mtshams nas dgra bgegs 'joms mdzad pa: dbyug sngon sder mo g.yag dang bya rog mgo: skal ldan= oṃ badzra kro dha nī la daṇḍa hūm̐: da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya= hūm̐ḥ lho yi phyogs nas dgra bgegs gsod mdzad pa: gshin rje dur khrod sha wa 'ug pa'i mgo: skal ldan= oṃ badzra kro dha ya mānta ka hūm̐: pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya= hūm̐: lho nub mtshams nas dgra bgegs sgrol mdzad pa: mi g.yo gtun khung gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo: skal ldan= oṃ badzra kro dha ārya a tsa la hūm̐: bhandha bhandha hūm̐ phaṭa:

kā ya= hūm̐: nub kyi phyogs nas dgra bgegs 'ching mdzad pa: rta mgrin gtum mo byi la pu shud mgo: skal ldan= oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya gṝ wa hūm̐: hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya= hūm̐: nub byang mtshams nas dgra bgegs 'gugs mdzad pa: 'dod rgyal mda' snyems ce spyang khra yi mgo: skal ldan= oṃ badzra kro dha a pa ra dzi ta hūm̐: tiṣṭha tiṣṭha hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya= hūm̐: byang gi phyogs nas dgra bgegs gnon mdzad pa: bdud rtsi rlung 'byin seng ge pha waṃ mgo: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛta kuṇḍa lī hūm̐: tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya wā ka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: byang shar mtshams nas dgra bgegs stob mdzad pa: khams gsum gsod ma dom dang sre mong mgo: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badzra kro dha trai lokya bi dza ya hūm̐: bhindha bhindha hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya wā ka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: 'og gi phyogs nas dgra bgegs spor mdzad pa: stobs chen skyod ma dred dang byi ba'i mgo: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badzra kro dha ma hā bā la hūm̐: spho ṭa spho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya wā ka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:
spyi bo'i gtsug tu dbang bskur ro: dam can rnams kyi sbams phur gyis dbang bskur ba ni:

hūm̐: bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs: sngon chad ji ltar khas blangs pa: khyod kyi dam tshig dus la bab: mngon spyod phrin las myur du mdzod: ha na ha na badzra: da ha da ha badzra: pa tsa pa tsa badzra: ma thā ma thā badzra: dzwa la dzwa la badzra: su ru su ru badzra: mu ru mu ru badzra: ka taṃ ka ye dza ye bi dza ye: a tsi te a pa ra tsi te: mā ra se na: pra mardha na ye hūm̐ phaṭa:
sha chen gyi dud pa gtang: dar nag g.yab: bshugs pa'i sgra dang rkang gling 'bud do: rdo rje gzhon nu'i mtshan ma rdzas kyi dbang bskur rdzogs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:
